description: Returns du'as from a curated du'a corpus for a life context (e.g. anxiety, travel, gratitude), with source and grading where recorded. Show any crisis_resource block verbatim.

context.description: Life context to match against. Examples: 'anxiety', 'morning', 'travel', 'forgiveness', 'gratitude'.

locale.description: Translation locale; defaults to "en". v1 returns English content for all locales.
